exposure: 2-octyl cyanoacrylate plus polymer mesh tape (2OPMT) for skin closure
conventional smooth sutures plus waterproof wound dressings (CS-WWD) for skin closure
outcome: total hospital costs for the cesarean delivery stay
30-day composite of cesarean wound surgical site infection and/or dehiscence

30-day composite of cesarean wound surgical site infection and/or dehiscence, puerperal infection, endometritis, urinary tract infection, hematoma of the skin, cellulitis, and/or other unspecified skin infection
cohort: Patients aged 18-49 who underwent cesarean delivery between October 1, 2015, and June 30, 2022, identified from over 1,000 U.S. hospitals.
finding: Cesarean deliveries using 2OPMT for skin closure were associated with significantly shorter post-surgical length of stay, lower total hospital costs, fewer 30-day readmissions, and lower incidence of 30-day clinical/wound complications compared to those using CS-WWD.
